# Fuling Ruin

Type: Point of interest | Internal ID: Ruin3 | Location: Plains | Resources: Plains chest | Inhabitants: Fuling

# Introduction

Fuling Ruins are Points of interest found in the Plains. They are small ruined stone buildings with a central stone staircase.

## Resources

There is always a Plains chest at the top of the staircases. Two Fulings are protecting the building.

Categorias: Points of interest
